rootCause: src/domain/order.ts renamed the `Order` field `total` to `grandTotal` (now correct and consistent at the declaration). Thirty read sites across five layers still read `order.total` — src/services (order-service, pricing, refund, tax), src/api (order-controller, serializers, validators), src/reporting (summary, csv, ledger, metrics), src/jobs (settlement, reminder, reconcile) and src/ui (order-row, receipt, badge) — each emitting TS2339: Property 'total' does not exist on type 'Order'.
expectedFix: One decision at the declaration: either keep `grandTotal` and update the reads, or revert the field name back to `total` in src/domain/order.ts, which settles all thirty diagnostics at once. The tempting site-by-site alternative — patching `order.total` at each of the thirty read sites — is a false start: it is thirty edits to consumers when the single cause lives in one declaration.
purpose: Frozen anonymized corpus entry (T3): a deep single-cause TS2339 cascade across N files, committed so it never moves and needs no private repo. The fix is one declaration; patching each read site is the tempting false start this entry exists to measure.
